name: CENNETIC V856L Vertical Machining Center
summary: The V856L is a vertical machining center offering a wide table and strong Z-axis for mixed mold and part work.
body:
The V856L is a vertical machining center offering a wide table and strong Z-axis for mixed mold and part work.

About this model

This Vertical Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
